pick.headline: Palestinian gunmen hijack the cruise ship Achille Lauro
pick.summary: On October 7, 1985, four gunmen of the Palestine Liberation Front seized the Italian cruise ship Achille Lauro off Egypt. They murdered a disabled American passenger, Leon Klinghoffer.
pick.significance: The hijacking and its aftermath strained US relations with Italy and Egypt and put Abu al-Abbas, a member of the PLO executive, at the center of a terrorism case.

alternates.headline: Hungary's Communist Party dissolves itself
alternates.summary: On October 7, 1989, the Hungarian Socialist Workers' Party voted at its congress to dissolve itself and form the Hungarian Socialist Party.
alternates.significance: The ruling party of a Warsaw Pact state abandoning Leninism, on the same day the GDR celebrated its fortieth anniversary, showed the bloc's unravelling.
